title: refactor: extract typed telemetry validation
description:
## Summary
- Extract the existing budget telemetry validation into a private `parseBudgetTelemetry` function and type-check its field names against `BudgetTelemetry`.
- Preserve accepted/rejected inputs, exact errors, public signatures, telemetry fields, and guard behavior. No feature, bug fix, or performance change is included.
- Commit characterization tests before the refactoring: real guard-to-parent telemetry round trips and malformed/missing/numeric-boundary input cases.
- Include the already-merged v0.8.3 release history (#75, `f1273fd`) from `main`. Its tree matched the merge base; the history merge also preserved the task branch tree.

## Verification
- Baseline `508ed35` (unchanged source tree): typecheck, 269 Node tests, 25 Python tests, package check passed.
- Characterization commit `aca2422`: typecheck and all 69 focused guard/subprocess tests passed before production edits.
- Refactoring head `7016d90`: typecheck and the same 69 focused tests passed; final full suite passed (271 Node + 25 Python tests), package check passed (21 files and 6 negative controls), and 9 skill-validator tests plus skill validation passed.
- Linux / Node 24.21.0 / Python 3.12.3; existing pinned development dependencies reused. Typecheck result applies to the committed unchanged input.
- Push CI on head `7016d90` and PR CI on test-merge `057bed8840f4d8be4f747bcb7e235e9f2dee3789` passed `skills`, `subagent`, and `subagent-macos`. The PR checkout SHA was verified in the job log.
- Pullfrog completed review of head `7016d90` with no findings; no unresolved review threads. Review: https://github.com/MDGChamomile/pi-subagent/pull/76#pullrequestreview-5558470361
- No live provider calls or active-environment installation.

## Risk
- Low: validation is moved without changing predicates or error boundaries. Typed key lists catch invalid names; they do not by themselves prove exhaustive schema coverage.
- Independent literal assertions and the writer/reader round trip remain in the tests. Child enforcement, process cleanup, and unknown-field rejection are unchanged.
- Revert the refactoring commit to restore the original function layout; no persisted-data migration or configuration changes are involved. The history-only merge need not be reverted.
- The configured automatic review sends PR content to the review service and uses its configured billing; no manual review trigger is requested.
